evidence: It gives log N(𝔭) exactly when the ideal is 𝔭^k with 𝔭 prime in the monoid of ideals (a nonzero prime ideal) and k ≥ 1, and 0 otherwise, which is the classical ideal von Mangoldt function. The choice in h.choose is harmless because ideal factorisation in 𝓞 K is unique, and the unit ideal gets 0 (vonMangoldt_one). Test mark made while setting up this repository.
